description: This file defines a custom annotation validator class 'FieldMatchValidator' used to validate that two fields in an object (typically within a form or DTO) have matching values, often used for password confirmation or similar use cases.

classes.name: FieldMatchValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if two fields in an object have matching values, typically used for confirming matching input fields.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the annotation parameters, setting field names to compare and creating a BeanUtils instance.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the two specified fields in the object have matching values, returns true if they match or are both null.
